# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/fasttext

## File: facebookresearch_fasttext/python/fasttext_module/fasttext/FastText.py

Prompts

```
['train a supervised text classification model from a labeled dataset file', 'train an unsupervised word embedding model (skipgram or cbow) from raw text', 'load a trained fasttext model and predict labels for a text input', 'evaluate a supervised model using precision, recall, and precision-recall curve metrics', 'get the vector representation of a word and its nearest neighbors in the embedding space']
```

Usage

```
{'train_supervised_model': 'train a supervised text classification model from a labeled dataset file', 'train_unsupervised_model': 'train an unsupervised word embedding model (skipgram or cbow) from raw text', 'load_model_and_predict': 'load a trained fasttext model and predict labels for a text input', 'evaluate_model_with_meter': 'evaluate a supervised model using precision, recall, and precision-recall curve metrics', 'get_word_vector_and_neighbors': 'get the vector representation of a word and its nearest neighbors in the embedding space'}
```
